mechanism: Establish one stable user and one complete experience object in the same frame. Before showing approval, isolate a tactile, material or functional close-up that visibly proves what the object does. Return to the same user for a complete first-use reaction chain, include one readable reset or relief action, then add a different detail for a second proof. End by repeating the opening relation with a clearly changed terminal object state and a settled user. The mechanism is objective proof to embodied reaction to terminal-state confirmation, not the source person, dish, market or exact food-vlog coverage.

invariants.rule: Establish one stable user and the complete experience object together before the first trial.
invariants.purpose: Defines who is testing what and provides an initial state.
invariants.ablation_failure: Opening on a macro detail alone removes identity and completion context.

invariants.rule: Show one independent close tactile, material or functional proof before relying on the user's reaction.
invariants.purpose: Makes the claim inspectable rather than testimonial.
invariants.ablation_failure: A reaction without object proof can feel staged or unsupported.

invariants.rule: Return to the same user for a complete first-use action, visible physical response and one reset or relief behavior.
invariants.purpose: Turns material evidence into embodied consequence.
invariants.ablation_failure: Cutting away before the response or omitting the reset leaves the experience incomplete.

invariants.rule: Add a second proof that uses a different object component, scale or action.
invariants.purpose: Broadens the demonstration and prevents one-gimmick repetition.
invariants.ablation_failure: Repeating the first insert at the same scale adds no new evidence.

invariants.rule: Repeat the opening user-object relation with a visibly changed terminal object state and a settled user.
invariants.purpose: Closes the test through before-after evidence.
invariants.ablation_failure: Ending on a bite, hand or isolated smile does not prove what happened to the object.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.
